blocks.text: Identifying a problem clearly is the first and most important step in problem solving. We must understand what the problem is asking. It is important to know the given information and the expected result. Asking simple questions helps in understanding the problem better. Unnecessary details should be ignored. A clear problem leads to a correct solution. This step helps save time and effort. Clear thinking makes problem solving easier.
